fields.label: Story headline
fields.name: story_headline
fields.instructions: The one-line story of this place. Under 10 words, no jargon. Example: Where others saw problems, we saw potential.

fields.label: Story intro
fields.name: story_intro
fields.instructions: 2 to 3 short paragraphs that open the narrative. Plain, confident sentences.

fields.label: Hero image
fields.name: hero_image
fields.instructions: Required. Minimum width 2400px. This is the full-bleed opening image; choose the strongest photograph of the finished place.

fields.label: Hero: second image (optional)
fields.name: hero_image_2
fields.instructions: With two images the hero splits side by side, like the reference design. Ignored when a hero video is set.

fields.label: Hero video (optional)
fields.name: hero_video
fields.instructions: Optional. A self-hosted MP4 URL or Vimeo link. The hero image is used as the poster.
